answer: The ridge counter is kept in whisper and hollow makes public each reset. An farming party thus has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 46 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 46 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. That bill is paid per identity, so 163 aliases cost 159 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
